functional.title: Merchant enrollment and order identity
functional.definition: Configure one participating seller, tenant access rules, buyer order lookup and callback identity. Introduce merchant-scoped idempotent order storage.

functional.title: Payment matching
functional.definition: Parse a verified connector receipt, normalize asset and amount, and join it to the original invoice and event reference.

functional.title: Asynchronous fulfillment
functional.definition: Implement a persistent asynchronous export job and merchant status adapter. Track monotonic revisions and readable evidence-backed artifact references.

functional.title: Case intake and redelivery
functional.definition: Deduplicate buyer cases, authorize same-buyer redelivery and implement short-lived grants to the original immutable artifact; record completion receipts or acknowledgment. Persist a fenced retrieval claim before streaming and record the authenticated digest receipt or buyer acknowledgment.

functional.title: Refund decision and settlement
functional.definition: Build full-refund eligibility, merchant approval, revocation of unconsumed grants and serialized disposition. Track dispatch and settlement distinctly.

functional.title: Support console and buyer timeline
functional.definition: Build case timeline, evidence-aware status, operator ownership, stale-case filters and buyer refresh. Include distinct proposed, authorized, pending and settled refund badges.

functional.title: Connector reconciliation and field trial
functional.definition: Replay omitted, duplicated, reordered and late merchant events through connector endpoints. Add metrics for unique resolved orders, second charges, time to retrieval and false closures.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Merchant enrollment and order identity
invariants.definition: An external order ID is unique only inside its merchant.

invariants.title: Payment matching
invariants.definition: A payment can fund at most one canonical order for a given transfer event.

invariants.title: Asynchronous fulfillment
invariants.definition: A ready state requires matching retrievable artifact bytes and digest.

invariants.title: Case intake and redelivery
invariants.definition: Redelivery cannot initiate a new purchase or change the delivered digest.

invariants.title: Refund decision and settlement
invariants.definition: An order with final delivery or an eligible in-flight refund cannot take the other terminal path automatically.

invariants.title: Support console and buyer timeline
invariants.definition: Case closure discloses the evidence for its terminal classification.

invariants.title: Connector reconciliation and field trial
invariants.definition: Event replay and process restart preserve original settlement and entitlement identities.
